bar.section: ### V. Recursive orchestration (to the next --- rule)
bar.rules: docs/product/capability-spec.md §1 (shared rules), §3 (pre-registration), §4 (measurement constraints); capability-spec-2.md §1.3 (verified per row kind), §1.5 (rows never R1 evidence)
fixedSequence: 1. Control properties (any breach voids the run): no tree exceeds its token (total and per worker), cost or wall budget, depth cap, concurrency cap or spawn caps; unmetered usage gives a null cost and refuses later spawns; the kill switch aborts in-flight workers, refuses later spawns and latches, leaving no orphaned desktop, worker trial or open ledger attempt; a ledger write failure halts the run.
2. Exact one-sided McNemar, V better than H on verified, p <= 0.05 with at least 5 discordant tasks.
guardrails: False done in V no higher than in either baseline (H, C1), else not shown.
Any false VERIFIED in V (a part the gate verified that the grader did not pass) halts the run: void.
Every worker trial is in the attempt ledger; a tree whose worker-trial count disagrees with the ledger is refused.

Parity (Part 1 §1.5): every row of every arm within the per-task token budget (limits.maxTotalTokens) and the step budget (stepBudget.desktopActionsPerPart x part count), else not shown (PARITY_FAILED).

While proposedPendingLeadRuling is non-empty or ratification is not recorded (status ratified with lead rulings and their timestamps), the decision is never shown (LEAD_RULING_PENDING); the numbers are still reported.

arms.V: planner plus gated workers through the orchestrator (src/orchestrate/), workers on the hcu+shell surface; gated rows
arms.C1: screenshot-only baseline, one agent; gate-less rows
arms.secondaryReported: V vs C1 (exact one-sided McNemar p and discordant count; never a bar component: the arms also differ by the shell channel)
arms.parity: same model, same orch-v1 task instance, same per-task total token and step budget in every arm

verified.V: done claim AND every part's gate verdict verified AND every part graded pass by the independent grader (src/benchmark/grade/)
verified.H: done claim AND every part graded pass by the independent grader
verified.C1: done claim AND every part graded pass by the independent grader
verified.falseDone: done claim AND any part graded fail or ungradable

seeds.taskBuild: part k of task orch-v1-NNN uses fixture seed orch-v1-NNN-k (src/orchestrate/orch-taskset.ts)
seeds.assignmentRule: per task, the order of the three arms' trials is a seeded shuffle of [V, H, C1] keyed by assignment seed and task id; one trial per (arm, task)
seeds.bootstrapNote: no ratio metric is a bar component in V; cost and wall time per verified are reported as point ratios

stepBudget.rule: per task, at most 30 x (part count) desktop actions, summed over every agent of the tree in V; the same total for the single agent in H and C1

limitsNote: the limits object is parsed as myco.orchestrate.limits/v1 for every V tree; maxTotalTokens is also the per-task token budget of H and C1 (parity). Estimate prices are the frozen claude-sonnet-5-5 rates in src/pilot/cost.ts; cost is a token-derived estimate, never billed USD.

test.name: exact one-sided McNemar (sign test on discordant tasks)
test.notShown: p > 0.05; fewer than 5 discordant tasks (reported as underpowered at n = 60 with the discordant count); a guardrail breached; a parity check failed; a lead ruling pending; or a refused pack
test.power: per Part 1 §1.5's table; at n = 60 a net gain of about 10-15 points may be underpowered, and a not-shown result is not evidence of no effect

secondary: cost per verified task: token-derived estimate over ALL trials (workers included) / verified; null if any trial is unmetered, never 0
kill-switch latency (worst observed; no pre-registered target)
V vs C1 exact one-sided McNemar

evidence.rows: experiment rows; never R1 evidence (capability-spec.md §3.4, capability-spec-2.md §1.5)
evidence.simulated: a simulated row, or a planner that is not the pre-registered model id, refuses the pack (§3.5)
evidence.packs: every pack records this pre-registration's hash (SHA-256 over canonical JSON of this file) and the commit it was frozen in (preregCommit, 40 hex); the analysis refuses a hash mismatch or a missing commit
evidence.constraints: Claude Ultra only ($0 Anthropic API, no Messages-API calls); no runs until the integrity fixes land and the lead gives GO for track V; Codex gated; no public leaderboard; V runs on Linux desktops (tracks L and U), never the Windows VM at first

proposedPendingLeadRuling: test.sided: one-sided against H only (Part 1 §1.5) vs #534's two-sided with Holm against both baselines (spec-2 §6)
verified: V gated vs H and C1 gate-less (spec-2 §1.3, §6); the alternative is a gate-present H
kill-switch latency target: none proposed; reported only (spec-2 §6)
limits.maxDepth and limits.maxConcurrentDesktops defaults (spec-2 §6), and the other limits values
stepBudget and the per-task token budget (limits.maxTotalTokens)

ratification.rule: a lead ruling is binding once posted; it is applied here, with its posting time and source, before the freeze. After the freeze any ruling (a changed value, or ratifying the pending ones) makes v-v2 (Part 1 §3.3). The analysis reads proposedPendingLeadRuling, leadRulings and ratification.status: while anything is pending or status is not ratified, the decision is never shown (LEAD_RULING_PENDING).
